summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss per the spec. Changes: monai/losses/dice.py (new numpy and torch.nn.functional imports; new class after GeneralizedDiceLoss with wasserstein_distance_map, compute_weights_generalized_true_positives, compute_generalized_true_positive, compute_denominator, and forward; alias generalized_wasserstein_dice added), monai/losses/__init__.py (exports GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss), and tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py (binary 2D and empty-class tests). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. The batch-coupling case was checked by hand (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333).
